meta.description: A task list screen inside a phone shell — status bar, home indicator, and a card that fills the display between them. Header with a primary action, a segmented filter, and date-grouped rows carrying completion, status, counts and collaborator faces. Two type sizes, two weights, three concentric radii, and one 16px column every left edge resolves to. The progress mark is a wedge drawn on the icon set's own grid, the last row sits mid-swipe with its delete action revealed, and the whole thing is OKLCH at a single hue. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.
